successCriteria.portlandRimBiasReduced: Portland top-10 median distance falls materially from its naturalist-interest value (24.2 mi)
successCriteria.distanceImprovesMostRegions: the median top-10 distance falls in at least 5 of 8 regions
successCriteria.interestRetentionHigh: mean naturalist-interest score of the top 10 falls by no more than ~2 points in every region
successCriteria.strongRoadsSurvive: the naturalist-interest #1 stays inside the exploration top 10 in every region
successCriteria.noCenterHugging: the top 10 is not dominated by roads at the centre: its mean interest stays within the retention rule
successCriteria.nearTiesResolveTowardNearer: among near-tied pairs (within 1 interest point) where the nearer road scores lower, the nearer road is preferred more often than not
successCriteria.deterministic: the same results and radius always produce the same order
